subject.title: Android: add adaptive app navigation sidebar

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this Material 3 bar/rail/permanent-drawer model as the replacement for the current Android navigation shell across phones, foldables, tablets, and desktop-sized windows?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes a broad, user-visible navigation contract rather than repairing a narrowly defined existing behavior; correctness tests cannot decide whether this is the intended product interaction model.

options.title: Sponsor the adaptive Material model
options.body: Accept the bar, rail, and permanent-drawer model after exact-head behavior proof and Android CI confirm the implementation.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Keep the current shell and request a smaller, explicitly scoped accessibility or compact-label repair instead of a navigation architecture replacement.

options.title: Pause for Android design direction
options.body: Hold the PR until an Android owner defines the target navigation behavior and supported window classes.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the adaptive Material model
recommendation.body: Accept the bar, rail, and permanent-drawer model after exact-head behavior proof and Android CI confirm the implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the latest branch repairs and are the strongest available history-based routing candidate for the current implementation.
